description: This file defines a Spring BeanPostProcessor that intercepts bean initialization to add sampling behavior based on configuration. It uses AOP proxies to wrap beans with sampling interceptors for performance diagnostics.

classes.name: SamplingBeanPostProcessor
classes.description: A Spring BeanPostProcessor that wraps beans with sampling interceptors if sampling is enabled and configured for the bean's class.

methods.name: postProcessAfterInitialization
methods.description: Intercepts bean initialization to apply sampling proxy if enabled.

methods.name: isSamplingEnabled
methods.description: Checks whether sampling is globally enabled via configuration.

methods.name: setSamplingServiceFactory
methods.description: Setter for injecting SamplingServiceFactory via dependency injection.

methods.name: setSamplingConfiguration
methods.description: Setter for injecting SamplingConfiguration via dependency injection.
